metaDescription: Why we built {siteName}: a place where Israelis and Jews find and book an apartment, a room or a house in Georgia, with hosts who promised to welcome them.

what.title: What {siteName} is
what.p1: {siteName} helps Israeli and Jewish travelers, families and investors find a place in Georgia: short stays, monthly rentals, hotels and homes for sale. Every host on the site has promised to welcome you.
what.p2: For those who need it, we also add what is hard to find out on your own: a kosher kitchen, Shabbat-friendly features, the walk to a synagogue, Shabbat times for every city and the holidays in the calendar.
what.p3: Short stays and hotel rooms can be booked right on the site: pick your dates, confirm, and pay the host when you arrive. We don't take payments. For monthly rentals and homes for sale, you contact the owner directly.

highlights.title: In short
highlights.a: Homes in Tbilisi, Batumi, Kutaisi and across Georgia
highlights.b: Short stays, monthly rentals and property for sale
highlights.c: Kosher and Shabbat details for those who need them
highlights.d: Instant booking for short stays, pay the host on arrival

story.title: Why we built Bayit
story.p1: When we traveled as a family and tried to rent a place on the big booking sites, most hosts turned us down, only because we are Jewish and from Israel.
story.p2: We didn't want any family to feel that way on their vacation.
story.p3: So we built Bayit: a place where Israelis and Jews can find and book an apartment, a room or a house in Georgia, without being afraid of being turned away and without hiding their religion or where they were born.
story.p4: Every host on Bayit promises to welcome you. So you can just sleep well and enjoy your trip.
story.p5: Our color is purple: Israel's blue and Georgia's red, together.

how.title: How it works
how.lead: Simple for guests, free for owners.

step1.title: Search and filter
step1.body: Filter by city, dates and price, and by Jewish-friendly details such as a kosher kitchen or the walk to a synagogue.

step2.title: Book or get in touch
step2.body: Short stays and hotels: pick your dates and the booking is confirmed right away. Monthly rentals and sales: contact the owner directly.

step3.title: Pay the host when you arrive
step3.body: You get the address and the host's contact, and you pay the host directly when you arrive. We take no payments and charge no booking fees.

how.link: See how it works in detail

values.title: What we stand for
values.lead: The promises behind every page of the site.

trust.title: Trust
trust.body: Every listing is checked, owners earn badges by proving who they are, and everyone sees safety tips at the moment they make contact. Trust is the product.

community.title: Community
community.body: Built for the community, with features that make it easier to keep your traditions while you travel. Everyone is welcome to use the site.

jewishFriendly.title: Jewish-friendly
jewishFriendly.body: Kosher kitchens, Shabbat-friendly homes, synagogue walking times, Shabbat times and holidays — details you would otherwise have to ask about one by one.

direct.title: Pay the host directly
direct.body: You pay the host on arrival, in cash, by card or by bank transfer, depending on what they accept. We take no payments and add no fee to your stay.

languages.title: Five languages
languages.body: Hebrew, English, Russian, Arabic and Georgian. Listings are translated automatically, so owners and guests understand each other.

contact.title: How to reach us
contact.lead: Questions, ideas or a problem with a listing — we're here to help.

help.title: Help center
help.body: Answers to common questions about searching, posting, contacting owners and safety.

form.title: Contact form
form.body: Write to the team, with or without an account. We reply by email.

email.title: Email
email.body: Prefer email? Write to us at <mailto>{email}</mailto>.
